mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward regression shows no significant positive relationship between GDPC1 and 20d returns (p > 0.05) or returns are not higher than baseline in expanding economies.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% but 5d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or in non-rising unemployment regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and decline in FEDFUNDS signals an economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS is not statistically significant (R-squared < 0.05) or returns are not higher than baseline in expansionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or in non-tightening regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The increase in INDPRO is not statistically significant or 20d returns are not higher than baseline in supply expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in UNRATE below 3.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 3.0% but 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or in non-improving labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and decline in UNRATE signal economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns are not higher than baseline in expanding economies.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (high UNRATE and CPIAUCSL), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The combination of high UNRATE and CPIAUCSL does not occur or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods.
